Backup settings & game saves

Settings save automatically in this browser. Backups include favorites, recently played, and game saves in this page’s local storage. Saves inside other websites, IndexedDB, cookies, or game files are not included. Import merges the backup and replaces matching saved values. Reload a game after restoring.

Changes save on this browser when storage is available. Appearance settings style the library, not game content.

What's new in Storm 0S

October 21, 2026

Online hub

  • Added access to Opium’s hosted proxy, games, and cloud interface, with a new-tab fallback.

Void Network

  • Added 70 games from Void’s standard and original-game catalogs.
  • Saved custom game links on the home page.
  • Optional confirmation before leaving in settings.

Libraries refreshed

  • Truffled now uses the supplied code's catalog: 289 games.
  • Frogie Arcade now uses the supplied code's catalog and launch links: 186 games.
  • Expanded to 24 libraries, keeping UGS only once.

A new home

  • Home page with Games, OS, and Desktop modes.
  • LumenOS-style workspace branded Storm 0S, with access to the shared game libraries.
  • Desktop mode opens TimmyMathWork.

Make it yours

  • 13 preset themes and appearance controls.
  • Settings and local save backup/import controls.
  • Storm 0S title stays fixed.

Extras and player

  • Embedded Extras, including Unblocked Zone and LumenOS.
  • Player controls for opening game HTML in a new tab, downloading, and hiding the bar.

Online games still depend on their original hosts. Game-save support varies by game.
